name: Ricardo Alonso
bio:
Ricardo Alonso's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. Originally trained as a mechanical engineer, he found himself drawn to the adrenaline and precision of racing after attending a local rally event. He transitioned from designing industrial machinery to crafting and refining race car components, a move that allowed him to apply his technical expertise in a dynamic and challenging environment.

At 23XI Racing, Ricardo is known for his meticulous approach to fabrication. He believes that every weld, every joint, and every component plays a crucial role in the car's performance and safety. His calm demeanor and unwavering focus make him an invaluable asset, particularly during high-pressure situations where precision and attention to detail are paramount. Ricardo's commitment to quality and his pragmatic problem-solving skills ensure that the team has the best possible equipment on the track.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Ricardo is a stocky man of average height, with a perpetually serious expression.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils to an exact point before starting any project.
Keeps a small, worn copy of a technical manual in his workbench drawer.
Quietly hums classical music while welding.
